2. **Chips:** Readable and well-spaced. The "Inside leg" chip is correctly highlighted without any visual interference.
3. **Visual Bugs:** None detected. The labels on the left interactive diagram remain legible, though the "Sleeve" label is now inactive/greyed out as expected when a different section is selected.
